events.verdict: Martin (IND) reaches across Wiggins' (GSW) body and makes contact with his shoulder prior to making any contact with the ball.
Martin (IND) and Wiggins (GSW) engage and disengage and marginal contact occurs during the cut to the basket, which does not affect Wiggins' ability to get to the pass.
Martin (IND) maintains his defensive position and absorbs the contact during Wiggins' (GSW) shot near the rim.
Sabonis (IND) is already in Wiggins' (GSW) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Green (GSW) is already in Brogdon's (IND) path and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Turner (IND) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Turner (IND) is already in Wiggins' (GSW) path and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Green (GSW) momentarily places his hand on Sabonis' (IND) side and marginal contact occurs as they move in the same direction.
Martin (IND) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to Golden State.
Wiggins (GSW) is already in Turner's (IND) path and is firming up when contact occurs.
Looney (GSW) is already in Brogdon's (IND) path and is firming up when contact occurs.
Turner (IND) jumps alongside Curry's (GSW) path and the marginal contact is caused by Curry slightly extending his legs back towards Turner during the driving shot attempt.
Curry (GSW) places his hand momentarily on Martin's (IND) hip and immediately removes his hand as they move up the lane line.
Green (GSW) briefly grasps Sabonis' (IND) shorts and marginal contact occurs as Sabonis deflects the ball away from Green during rebounding.
Green (GSW) is already in Brogdon's (IND) path and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Brogdon (IND) contests the jump shot to the side of Curry (GSW), and the marginal contact is caused by Curry.
Porter Jr. (GSW) and Martin (IND) pursue the rebound and marginal contact occurs after the ball is deflected.
LeVert's (IND) forearm makes clean contact with the ball contact as he defends Looney's (GSW) shot near the rim.
Payton II (GSW) briefly grasps and immediately releases LeVert's (IND) jersey off ball.
Sabonis (IND) is already in Wiggins' (GSW) path and is firming up when contact occurs.
Toscano-Anderson (GSW) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting the lane.
Payton II (GSW) is moving alongside LeVert's (IND) path and maintains a legal guarding position as LeVert loses his balance during his drive to the basket.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: LeVert (IND) is the last player to touch the ball before it rolls out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to Golden State.  The game clock continues to run after the ball goes out of bounds until 02.2, which is not noticed in game.  Clock malfunctions are only reviewable when the clock continues to run to 00:00.
Brissett (IND) and Poole (GSW) engage and disengage and marginal contact occurs before Brissett cleanly intercepts the pass.
